activity.metadata_only_verification: Read/hashes and JSON construction/parse of owned design metadata only; no target scientific payload/decoder or source was imported/executed.

adapter_contract.actual_bootstrap: bootstrap_root, bootstrap_capability, bootstrap_api are the same objects Root._entry injected, not caller descriptors, imported substitutes, or objects recovered from JSON.
adapter_contract.authority_boundary: Adapter passing authentic objects preserves the external Root-source selection premise. This is not Python self-authentication; it depends on the trusted launcher/Root/OS/interpreter/stdlib specified below.
checks_before_source_execution: Require optimize==0 and api[0]() equals pinned Root; validate actual capability with api[1](capability, exact provider pin); retain actual initially supplied root/API and source-owned operation aliases.

Require exact newstage integration adapter path, no symlink components, new external output path computed by the selected parent/guard run; output must not exist and cannot be below stage or frozen root.

Require accepted producer source complete digest/size/mode; actual Root._hash_regular on stage/baseline/full_driver.py with finite bound; authenticated API calls on both sides. The accepted producer is not edited.

Build exactly [producer_path, --frozen-root, stage/baseline/frozen, --reference, stage/baseline/reference/certificates/complex-network.json, --mode, profile, --output, guard_science_path]. Do not pass --anchor, --lanes, --finite-only or optimization flags to producer.

Create root.ModuleType(__main__) with exact producer __file__, builtins owner, and the unchanged actual bootstrap objects. Set its __name__ to __main__; save prior sys.argv object and sys.modules[__main__] identity; set producer argv/module alias.

Use root._COMPILE(exact_source, exact_producer_path, exec, dont_inherit=True, optimize=0), api currentness checks, then root._EXEC(code, fresh_producer_namespace). This is the same admitted source-execution leaf as Root._entry, not importlib/runpy reconstruction of the producer.
adapter_contract.completion: Only ordinary successful return through the unchanged producer._g12_reference_entry is eligible for adapter postchecks. The adapter never catches the producer marker to manufacture success and never calls producer internals separately.
adapter_contract.input_argv: Exactly [absolute_adapter_path, --output, absolute_guard_run_science_path, --lanes, g12-reference]; no other arguments.
adapter_contract.restoration_and_errors: After source execution, require producer argv/module aliases retain their expected identities before restoration. Restore only owned slots once; retain first raw exception/traceback and ordered secondary errors, emit stderr where possible; any secondary blocks ordinary adapter success. Do not overwrite a foreign slot or replace the original primary. Require api[0] and producer source bytes unchanged after return.

authority.scope: Parent delegated bounded G12 custody design only; independent exact design review required before implementation; no execution authority.

cold_consumer_design.authenticity_limit: Source selection of the parent manifest/publication record establishes immutable data provenance under the trusted launcher. Consumer does not recreate parent Popen/lease/owner from JSON; absence of valid source selection stays closed.
cold_consumer_design.caller_authority: Only the existing authenticated cold registered-source entry may call it, passing initially captured actual Root/capability/API before candidate exposure. Verify its exact source/argument ownership there; function shape checks alone cannot authenticate a supplied root.
cold_consumer_design.costs: All reads, hashes, strict parsing, complete hex decode, final triple/pair rechecks, retained memory and source/cold checks are charged to the actual candidate/reference invoice. No reference production or custody is amortized away or treated as free.
order: Call authentic api[0] and api[1](capability, expected provider pin), verify selected consumer function/source identity and pristine source-owned read/JSON/hash operation aliases under the cold entry; None fails immediately.

Read exact source-selected manifest with complete bytes/mode/path identity checks and original Root._hash_regular on both sides. Root._hash_regular L480-506 alone does not check full mode or final path identity; add source-owned nofollow/dirfd/full-mode checks without modifying Root.

Parse strict manifest schema; require pinned parent source identity and exact fixed Root/provider/adapter/producer/authority/guard/workload/argv bindings. Validate complete successful guard and actual-terminal fields as part of authenticated parent manifest data, not as independently trusted booleans.

Verify the source-selected final publication/accounting record joins this exact manifest digest and parent source and records successful final close/tail; do not synthesize it from manifest fields. Retained original raw evidence remains fully available; manifest holds complete parent-validated original START/receipt field joins.

Read both retained common and diagnostic complete files under actual Root and fixed manifest FileRecords, strict exact schema/crosslink checks, decode full common hex and hash it; retain complete raw diagnostic bytes/provenance even though it is not a candidate equality output.

After decode, re-read manifest and BOTH retained exports and publication record, recheck complete hashes, modes, identities and directory bindings together, then authentic Root/API currentness and selected consumer ownership once more. Mutation of diagnostics after the first common read rejects.

Expose only observed exact bool literal, positive exact int count, opaque complete common bytes, and immutable provenance including manifest/pair/publication/source/workload pins. Keep full diagnostics in parent retention; do not promote diagnostic counters to expected scientific equality values.
cold_consumer_design.original_transport_not_adopted: The existing common-only fourtuple draft is insufficient and remains unselected; it is a location/pattern reference only, not an accepted transport dependency.
cold_consumer_design.source_selection: G12_REFERENCE_HANDOFF = None remains unchanged in the existing draft. Proposed new consumer also starts None. Later immutable source literal is (manifest_absolute_path,manifest_sha256,manifest_bytes,manifest_identity,parent_source_path,parent_source_sha256,final_publication_record_path,final_publication_record_sha256,final_publication_record_bytes). This is source-selected after actual parent custody and final accounting; no runtime setter/callback/registry.

design_decisions: Use a G12-specific trusted parent with its own actual Popen of the unchanged original guard. Do not call the full historical composed controller or relabel the current funded runner as a G12 executor.

Use the existing actual Root/provider bootstrap and one small fixed integration adapter. The adapter source-executes the unchanged producer from the baseline directory using the actual Root/capability/API objects it received from Root._entry.

A scoped known-process observation leaf follows the current supervisor generation/pidfd pattern. It does not claim universal writer exclusion or a hostile-fork sandbox. Missing/denied/ambiguous observations fail closed.

Create the immutable retained parent domain only after successful guard join and known process/stream cleanup. It is outside every declared child output subtree and has no inherited directory or writable file descriptor.

Parent source-owned completion, exact original guard START/receipt/raw logs, both complete exports and known custody must all join before sealing. A serialized PASS, caller success boolean, common-only payload or diagnostic completion text is insufficient.

Later cold consumption authenticates a separately source-selected manifest and both retained exports under the actual Root. It transports original literal/count/common bytes and provenance; it does not reconstruct a live parent or add a new oracle.

All current runtime/source selections remain None. Actual future output hashes are values produced by the future successful custody operation; they are not prerequisites to this source design or a reason to invent payloads.

finite_IO_contract.FileIdentity: Exact tuple(dev:int>=0, ino:int>0, full_st_mode:int, size:int>=0, mtime_ns:int, ctime_ns:int); retain nlink:int and require regular, nonsymlink, nlink==1 for named files. Exclude atime only because own reads may change it.
finite_IO_contract.cap_semantics: Finite rejection ceilings only, not a resource grant or evidence that actual data fits. Original 1GiB/resource/body caps still apply to simultaneous raw bytes, JSON trees, decoded hex and copies; over-cap or insufficient paid headroom blocks before materialization. Any actual size above selected bound is a visible closed branch, not silent truncation.
finite_IO_contract.current_action: These are source requirements only; no export file or runtime evidence has been read or decoded.
finite_IO_contract.future_decoder_limits: Source-fixed depth <=256; decoded node_count <= the relevant fixed file byte ceiling; individual string/hex length <= that ceiling. These are exact defensive rejection limits, checked within genuine memory/time budget. No relaxation/retry during actual custody.
finite_IO_contract.json: Exact UTF-8/ASCII canonical producer JSON plus one newline, duplicate keys rejected by object_pairs_hook at all levels, reject NaN/Infinity, only exact builtin JSON primitives; booleans never pass integer fields. Bound raw bytes before decoding, decoded depth/node/hex work by selected finite limits inside actual resource/time budget. Do not execute target scientific decoders or import producer to validate data.
finite_IO_contract.read_pair: Use authenticated source-owned openat/no-follow directory traversal and held dirfd, O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW|O_NONBLOCK|O_CLOEXEC. lstat/path identity == opened fstat == post-read fstat == final lstat. Read exactly initial size in bounded chunks plus bounded EOF confirmation; short read, growth, replacement, changed mode/link count, wrong parent directory, or close error rejects. Recheck both originals jointly after both reads and before commit; retained copies receive same checks.
finite_IO_contract.write_copy: Exclusive O_CREAT|O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW|O_CLOEXEC; partial writes loop with positive progress; hash all written bytes; fsync/fchmod/readback/known close; no copy operation is assumed complete from its return status alone.

full_cost_invoice.accounting_rule: Measure whole parent entry through final close/retention/publication with monotonic wall and self+children CPU, preserve original GNU time/guard raw measurements and peak/lifetime memory observations, and separately meter later cold-consumer work. Nested producer phase timings are not added as if disjoint. No reclassification of profile as performance sample.
full_cost_invoice.bounds: Preserve first failure and every observed cap; never silently truncate complete files to fit, reroll a failure, hide secondary cost or drop diagnostic retention.
full_cost_invoice.execution_gate: Actual later run must have a separately authorized exact source-owned budget/phase covering entire parent/reference/custody/consumer/publication costs. Original guard phase/lock/limit checks remain unchanged. Future numerical caps/reservations are not invented here. Lack of runtime authority does not block construction/review of this closed source design.

full_cost_invoice.tail_rule: Manifest stores preseal costs and exact billing boundaries. After manifest write/readback and actual lease close, a fixed source-owned final-publication record joins manifest hash and complete operation costs through its own pre-write point. A separately retained authoritative enclosing completion charge covers final-record write/readback/close and final source-selection publication. The enclosing receipt cannot be replaced by a self-reported completed flag. If no actual authorized enclosing source-owned accounting path covers that last tail, selection remains None; no infinite self-accounting recursion or free tail claim.

known_process_and_namespace_contract.failure_limit: If failed launch/guard leaves an unseen or unadopted descendant outside observed known ownership, source records cleanup UNKNOWN and never seals. It must not claim a universal cleanup result from inherited process-group kill alone.
known_process_and_namespace_contract.leaf_basis: Current supervisor proc/census/generation/children_now L114-146 and OwnedDomain L205-309; use only this finite G12 observation/cleanup leaf, not bind_active_run_root or current controller. No native subreaper installation is required for successful fixed wait chain under stated premise; no claim about arbitrary orphaning/hostile fork.
known_process_and_namespace_contract.mandatory_leaf_differences: PermissionError, malformed/oversized process metadata, failed descriptor close, unknown observation, generation ambiguity or unsupported pidfd operation is a STOP/unknown result; never interpret it as empty. Never signal parent or a PID without retained generation/pidfd. Initial parent child set and thread set must be empty/single-task; no concurrent children may be created.
known_process_and_namespace_contract.namespace: Original guard run folder and producer science directory are fixed from the selected label, were absent before launch, and are retained by identity after join. Parent lease and source-selected role restrictions exclude another cooperating writer. Directory FD chain checks reject symlink components/rename/substitution. Symlink/hardlink/foreign names and unexpected output alias ownership block pair custody.
known_process_and_namespace_contract.parent_domain: Fresh R/runtime/g12-reference-parent-custody-v1/<label> is created only after known writers have completed. It is outside R/runtime/runs/<label>/science and outside all staged/frozen roots. No retained-directory FD was available to children. Directory 0700 while writing, 0500 after seal; files 0444. Same-UID/chmod resistance to hostile outsiders is not claimed.
known_process_and_namespace_contract.selected_successful_chain: New parent -> actual original guard -> /usr/bin/time -> actual Root -> adapter -> profile/no-anchor producer in the same Root process. Producer candidate-only build_native and native control branches are unreachable (producer L201-218). Original CLI uses same-process runpy at L257-265.
known_process_and_namespace_contract.source_only_now: No process inspection, Popen, child cleanup, lock acquisition, source loading, stage mount or runtime directory creation was performed.
known_process_and_namespace_contract.trusted_closed_role_premise: Selected fixed scientific sources, adapter and ordinary profile branch do not fork/spawn threads, daemonize, pass writable descriptors to outsiders, or enlist external writers. Trusted OS/loader/interpreter/stdlib and cooperating same-user parent launch domain exclude unrelated writer interference. This is an explicit finite source/operating premise, not established merely by a clean /proc snapshot.

launch_selection_schema.accounting_selection: Exact source pin and fixed entry of the separately authorized existing enclosing accounting owner and its original body/tail allocation. This design never substitutes a caller callback or serialized funding boolean. No actual execution source selection exists in this packet.
launch_selection_schema.directory_paths: Fixed R/runtime/g12-reference-parent-observation-v1/<label> for prelaunch logs and R/runtime/g12-reference-parent-custody-v1/<label> for retained evidence after cleanup. The latter must not exist until P07.
launch_selection_schema.label: Exact source-selected nonempty simple ASCII label accepted by unchanged guard, no runtime choice. Full paths are derived once from that source label; existence rejects, and only one Popen attempt is permitted.
launch_selection_schema.numeric_types: body_deadline_ns and retention_tail_allowance_ns exact positive int, latter no larger than genuine existing paid allowance. No values granted here. Failed source/owner/budget gate leaves selection closed.
launch_selection_schema.phase_pin: Exact known original EXECUTION-PHASE.json SourcePin and original budget semantics; no phase read is performed during this design.
launch_selection_schema.source_pins: Exact selected sources required by manifest schema, with complete staged closure supplied by STAGE.json. Parent expected digest is supplied by authentic external source selection; parent source does not contain its own digest.

Retain actual result/Popen-owner path; serialization never reconstructs live ownership.

new_stage_design.future_digest_rule: New adapter/stage/parent source digests must be computed from independently reviewed bytes at source selection; they cannot be fake hashes or runtime setter inputs. No self-referential source/plan hash cycle.
new_stage_design.manifest_rule: New immutable STAGE.json and JOBS.json enumerate exactly the staged closure including adapter, Root, provider, baseline producer/source/reference and correct authority; runner_sha256 is unchanged original guard. No existing stage is edited. Root/provider runtime file pins remain unchanged.

baseline/engine/.constraint: Exact original seven ENGINE_PINS entries at producer L33-41, original modes; no source modification.

baseline/frozen/.constraint: Exact 32-file SOURCE-PINS closure, original modes, no symlinks; original producer inventory remains authoritative.

integration/RUNTIME-PROFILE.json.source: Exact file named by provider._profile_files at historical stage integration; preserve provider runtime/header preflight.

new_stage_design.shape_reason: Producer.__file__ at stage/baseline/full_driver.py makes HERE baseline and its rsplit(/,2)[0] authority reference resolve to stage/areas/cache-validity/cold_authority_v7.py exactly.

original_guard_acceptance_predicate.joins: Receipt shared START fields are type-exact equal to exact START bytes and the parent prelaunch selection. START command is exactly the Root/provider/adapter argv the unchanged guard constructs; producer argv is exactly the adapter source derivation. Run label/job/stage SHA/guard SHA/Root/provider/adapter/producer/authority/reference/frozen/engine pins all bind one invocation. Parent stdout echoes receipt from guard; it is checked for consistency but never substitutes for the canonical receipt.
original_guard_acceptance_predicate.limits: Original timeout 180 seconds, aggregate existing phase 600 or 2400 only, sampled process group RSS <=1GiB, runner lifetime RSS <=1GiB, usage metadata <=16KiB, no source/log drift. Preserve original current spent/cap checks; no new cap is granted by this document.
original_guard_acceptance_predicate.no_reconstruction: No replayed caller dictionary, diagnostic completion sentence, receipt status alone, file existence, helper callback or future desired digest can supply the genuine parent invocation owner.
original_guard_acceptance_predicate.outer: Actual private Popen exists, exact guard source launch, actual returncode int==0, original primary absent, no parent STOP, complete known cleanup, known closed outer logs, unchanged initial source/namespace/lease bindings.
original_guard_acceptance_predicate.raw_log_checks: Recompute complete stdout/stderr bytes and SHA256 from retained files, check final sizes and identities, original 2MiB per stream, empty stderr, and complete outer raw logs; outer stderr must be empty. Original guard and producer diagnostics remain raw retained evidence.
original_guard_acceptance_predicate.usage: Retain original usage.json raw bytes; require exact expected GNU time record user_seconds/system_seconds/kernel_max_rss_kib/exit with finite nonnegative values and exact exit int zero for complete accounting. Missing/malformed/oversized usage is nonqualifying, not a fabricated zero.

parent_functions_in_required_order.contract: Fresh trusted parent entry, no public success/result/manifest arguments. G12_REFERENCE_LAUNCH_SELECTION is None in source-only derivative. A later independently selected exact launch literal is required before any runtime operation. Construct one private invocation record; caller cannot deserialize/mint it or provide completion fields.
parent_functions_in_required_order.function: run_g12_reference() -> source-owned sealed-result or raised original failure

parent_functions_in_required_order.contract: Verify exact source selection, initial interpreter/stdlib/native TCB and clean launch, stage/plan pins, fixed argv, exact existing original execution-phase pin and authorized full invoice. Reject prior output/evidence/custody paths. Hold the actual separate parent-queue lease through finish; preserve its FD/device/inode/known mode and currentness. Original guard retains its own science.lock; never pre-lock that same guard lock and deadlock it. No wait behind contention or retry.

Retain actual subprocess.Popen of [/usr/bin/python3.12,-S,-s,-P,-B,R/run_guarded_v3.py,g12-reference-custody-v1,g12-reference,label], cwd R, exact clean ENV, close_fds=True, start_new_session=True. Open exclusive outer raw log files in parent observation directory and retain actual descriptors. Set attempted state before Popen; at most one attempt. Capture actual PID/start ticks/PGID/SID before poll/wait and retain that same Popen object.

Own and monitor the actual selected guard process/known descendants using the scoped generation/pidfd leaf; retain original wall/RSS/raw-log limits plus selected complete-body deadline and cleanup reserve. Join actual Popen. Require actual returncode exact int zero, no parent STOP/exception, no current known descendant/group/child, all owned pidfd/outer-log descriptors known closed, and a complete observation. A diagnostic status string is not this predicate.

Under the still-held lease and known namespace, complete-read original START.json, receipt.json, stdout.txt, stderr.txt, usage.json plus parent LAUNCH and raw outer logs. Require exact run/stage/job/argv/source/fractions/phase bindings and all original success/resource/custody predicates below. Preserve every raw file; missing receipt stays missing. No receipt reconstructed from outer stdout.

Only after P04/P05, open exactly the two named exports relative to the retained owned science-directory descriptor, perform bounded complete identity-stable reads, validate both primitive envelopes and all cross-links, then repeat both file snapshots together. Missing/partial diagnostic makes otherwise complete common nonqualifying.

Create fresh parent retained directory after known cleanup; exclusive-create byte-identical copies of both complete exports and exact launch/guard/raw evidence. Complete writes, fsync, chmod/fchmod 0444, known close, directory sync and complete readback. Keep original identities and retained identities separately; do not alter child original bytes/modes. Any failure retains partial data with no seal.

Nested source-private closure, no caller-supplied success flag or externally supplied completion object. Recheck same actual Popen/lease/namespace/no children/known IO, original and retained pair hashes and source closure; emit fixed manifest only from retained actual observations. Manifest exclusive create, fsync, 0444, known close, directory sync and exact readback. After final tail and lease-close success, return immutable source-owned candidate pin for later separate source adoption. Until then no output is qualified.

Always bounded known cleanup and necessary final retention, charging costs. Preserve primary and ordering, do not overwrite partial/foreign files or mint a PASS/manifest substitute. Incomplete cleanup/unknown IO/failed final close remains open and blocks publication; no reroll. A fully written manifest before a failed final tail is still unselected and nonqualifying.

parent_manifest_schema.FileRecord: Exact {path,sha256,bytes,identity,nlink}; path absolute canonical string; identity six exact fields dev,ino,full_st_mode,size,mtime_ns,ctime_ns; nlink==1. bytes==identity.size. sha256 lowercase64. No stable=True substitutes for these checked values.
parent_manifest_schema.ProcessRecord: Exact object {pid,ppid,pgid,sid,start_ticks,state,rss_bytes}; pid/ppid/pgid/sid/start_ticks/rss_bytes exact nonnegative ints (pid>0); state exact source-observed bounded process-state string. Owned identity is (pid,start_ticks), never PID alone. Group exact {pgid,sid}. DirectoryIdentity exact {dev,ino,full_st_mode,mtime_ns,ctime_ns}; mutation checks account only for explicitly owned new-file creates and are resealed afterward.
parent_manifest_schema.SourcePin: Exact object {path:absolute canonical str,sha256:lowercase64,bytes:exact nonnegative int,mode:four-digit octal string}; parent source identity is authenticated by the external trusted source selection, never its own reported digest. engine is exact producer ENGINE_PINS mapping; cleanup_leaf_origin pins the inspected supervisor source and its fixed extraction/review identity.
parent_manifest_schema.accounting: Exact source-fixed boundaries and raw references described by full_cost_invoice below; every actual time/count field finite primitive and explicit present or nonqualifying, no fabricated zero. Post-manifest publication tail is in an independently retained final source-selection/publication record, because manifest cannot hash its own final close and publication costs.
parent_manifest_schema.accounting_values: clock is monotonic_ns; exact clock endpoints and wall_ns exact nonnegative ints with end>=begin and difference equality; resource values finite nonnegative exact numbers, no bool. categories is the exact ordered full_cost_invoice category list. guard_usage and guard_runner_wall_seconds join canonical actual guard receipt. complete_tail_accounting_required is true. enclosing_accounting_source_pin matches authentic source selection and gives no grant on its own.
parent_manifest_schema.cleanup_values: remaining and current_children exactly []; known closes true; io_unknown false; positive ownership records from actual live source observation. operating_premises are exact bounded text/constants from this design, not a claim of all-OS writer proof.
parent_manifest_schema.custody_values: New parent retained directory, full identity, file_mode0444, created_after_known_cleanup true, source_selection_required true; any unknown close blocks. No live capability is serialized.
parent_manifest_schema.guard_content: start/receipt/stdout/stderr/usage are retained FileRecords. start_fields and receipt_fields reproduce the validated exact original objects from raw files; their encodings/hashes join the retained raw pins. Preserve original raw bytes, including formatting.
parent_manifest_schema.immutability_and_cycle_rule: Do not place manifest hash inside itself. Only after complete known writes/closes/readback, final tail and lease close may later separately authorized source selection pin its exact path/hash/size/identity plus parent source pin. Manifest or pair files existing without that selection remain nonqualifying.
parent_manifest_schema.launch_record: Complete retained LAUNCH.json FileRecord; actual parent prelaunch plan and captured generation are distinct time-ordered records if needed. No PID is itself authority.
parent_manifest_schema.pair_value: common and diagnostics each exact {original:FileRecord,retained:FileRecord}; both raw file names fixed; both complete. Their original and retained full bytes/SHA/size match; retained mode0444 and known parent directory identity. Pair payload digest joins common and diagnostic schema data.
parent_manifest_schema.retained_evidence: Exact fixed mapping of original guard START, receipt, stdout, stderr, usage; parent launch, outer stdout, outer stderr, owned-observation and accounting records. Every member complete and immutable; no caller-chosen file list.
parent_manifest_schema.scope: Fixed source-data custody only. No G12/P02/full-positive/native/performance/scientific admission; no universal writers theorem.
parent_manifest_schema.terminal_values: actual_popen_returncode exact int 0; wait_completed true; parent_stop/primary_error None; secondary_errors empty list; guard_receipt_missing false. These are emitted from the retained live Popen/owner closure, never accepted from a caller.

publication_record_schema.tail: enclosing_tail_join_required is true and pins the authentic enclosing source whose actual completion charge covers final-record write/close/readback and later source-selection publication. The record alone cannot supply that authority. Later handoff adoption must join this real enclosing completion; missing/failed tail leaves None. No universal self-accounting theorem or invented funding.
publication_record_schema.values: Manifest pin is computed only after its complete write/close/readback. retained_pair_sha256 is exact {common,diagnostics} matching manifest; final pair recheck and known lease close are actual parent-owned observations. primary_error None and secondaries [] only on success. measured_through_ns identifies exactly the last included clock point; actual_costs_through_ns contains exact wall/self/children CPU and finite memory values through that point, never a claim about future own-write cost.

review_gate.not_requested: No runtime, target import, tests, helpers, compiler, native, decoder, science, locks, process inspection, network, historical audit or implementation.
review_gate.request: Independent bounded source-design review of exact frozen DESIGN-v1.json and SOURCE-PINS-v1.json before any implementation; review whether every branch is operational under the stated finite TCB and whether any concrete missing source predicate remains.
review_targets: adapter actual Root/bootstrap/source/argv compatibility with accepted producer unchanged
actual Popen+original receipt+complete pair single-owner join
known cleanup and source-owned namespace assumptions without universal proof inflation
exact strict manifest/pair/consumer schemas and closed source selection
immutable retention and final accounting/publication tail without self-report authority
original controls/scopes and full cost invoice preserved

scope.no_new_authorization: No new budget, reservation, native qualification, performance, science, PROFILE_ANCHOR_PASS, FULL_PASS, G12 approval or broader-goal status change.
scope.one_fixed_role: independent-original-uncached G12; h=25; extra_target=(0,2,1); normal optimize0; original profile/no-anchor invocation
scope.preserve: Every original failure, partial export, raw error, source pin and historical frozen file remains intact. No repair/reroll or reconstruction of absent canonical receipts.
scope.separate_P02: P02 retains its own standard-workload independent double-reference/rank/complement/native equality obligations. G12 diagnostics never satisfy them.

source_map.finding_preserved: No exact current G12 success plus complete two-export custody API was established in the bounded inspected closure.

stop: Freeze exact design and wait for independent review. No implementation/adoption/execution in this assignment.

common_constants.scope: Actual original N22 literal and P07 common remainder observations only; no original PROFILE_ANCHOR_PASS, FULL_PASS, native qualification or G12 approval.

two_export_schema_and_crosslinks.common_observed: literal_original_value is actual exact bool, not required to be True and not prefilled. remaining_original_case_count is actual exact int>0, not an invented answer. common_payload_hex is lowercase even-length complete hex. Recompute SHA256(decoded complete bytes) == common_payload_sha256. All SHA fields lowercase64.
two_export_schema_and_crosslinks.common_payload_prefix: Tagged JSON exactly follows producer._g12_primitive/_g12_bytes. Validate primitive tag structure without constructing foreign objects. Top-level tuple has exactly ten members, whose first four are str(g12-original-remainder-common-v1), tuple(original_scientific_pins), int(25), tuple(int(0),int(2),int(1)); last six preserve original code bytes, role return, full return, certificate bytes, stdout and suffix-phase tuple. Last tuple is verify_role_frames,full_log_integer_bounds,original_upstream_verify_sources,original_serializable,complete_original_cli. Validate canonical primitive tags/lengths and exact prefix/workload; return opaque complete bytes. Do not recompute scientific answers or compare native/cache counters here.
two_export_schema_and_crosslinks.complement_receipt_types: calls and canonical_stream_bytes exact nonnegative int; sha256 lowercase64; schema exact v2-jsonl:call,us,vs,result(type=list+values or type=None); ordered exact integer vectors. Preserve cumulative receipts as cumulative, without digest subtraction.

diagnostic_constants.complement_suffix_limit: Only cumulative original start/end receipts; no digest subtraction or suffix-stream claim.
diagnostic_constants.completion: Exact source-owned intentional marker followed by original finally, exact observer restoration, both cold2 checks and original source/output custody.

two_export_schema_and_crosslinks.diagnostic_snapshot_types: prefix_end/suffix_start/cli_end are exact dicts of listed keys; rank_event_count exact nonnegative int; ordered_rank_events_hex canonical lowercase even-length hex of original primitive rank-event tuple; native_binding and cache_binding exactly None, never fabricated zero. Retain full bytes for all three snapshots.
mandatory_links: common.selected_driver_sha256 == diagnostic.selected_driver_sha256 == independently selected producer source pin
diagnostic.common_payload_sha256 == common.common_payload_sha256 == recomputed complete decoded payload SHA
common source/workload prefix == independently selected original source/workload tuple
full file SHA/size/mode/identity of both original and retained files == manifest pair records; manifest source/workload/hash pins == independent consumer source selection
two_export_schema_and_crosslinks.no_selfreport_authority: Schema/completion/scope strings are checked for expected data shape only. Actual successful launch+completion and custody are supplied by the source-owned parent path, not these strings.
two_export_schema_and_crosslinks.phase_record: Each exact dict has calls exact int==1, wall_seconds and cpu_seconds_with_children finite nonnegative exact int/float (not bool). Preserve all phase bytes and treat times as nested diagnostics, never additive total costs.
two_export_schema_and_crosslinks.rank_suffix: ordered_rank_suffix_hex is complete canonical lowercase hex of tagged tuple(rank events); validate finite primitive shapes. It remains diagnostic; its presence does not establish standard-workload P02 equality.

tagged_primitive_grammar.Fraction: [Fraction-tag, canonical numerator decimal str, canonical positive denominator decimal str]; actual producer Fraction is normalized; validation may check normalization with bounded exact stdlib arithmetic under charged budget, but no new scientific result is computed.
tagged_primitive_grammar.None: [None-tag] where tag text is None; list length1.
tagged_primitive_grammar.dict: [dict-tag, exact list of exact length2 lists of recursively valid key/value tags]; do not collapse/reorder the list into a dict while checking common bytes.
tagged_primitive_grammar.float: [float-tag, exact str in canonical float.hex() output domain]; preserve producer-supported tag representation without treating it as a JSON NaN/Infinity token.
tagged_primitive_grammar.general: Every encoded value is an exact JSON list with one known tag and its exact arity. Preserve all ordering, including dict-pair order. Do not materialize scientific classes or call arbitrary equality/constructors.
tagged_primitive_grammar.int: [int-tag, canonical decimal str] with optional leading minus, no leading zeros except 0, no plus or negative zero.
tagged_primitive_grammar.tuple_or_list: [tuple-tag or list-tag, exact list of recursively valid tags].
